findings.title: Removing findMany breaks the existing service API
findings.body: The service previously exposed findMany(args), which executed a query with authorization and filter conditions applied. This change removes that method and replaces it with getBaseConditions(), which returns SQL rather than query results. Existing consumers of findMany will no longer compile (or will throw at runtime), and consumers of the condition-building methods must also switch from Prisma where inputs to raw SQL. This PR only updates the service and its integration tests; retain a compatible query method or migrate the consumers together with this API change.

findings.title: Keep the returned base predicate grouped when no filters are present
findings.body: For team and organization scopes with members, authConditions contains two branches joined by OR. When no service filters are supplied, getBaseConditions returns that expression without enclosing parentheses. Composing it as `WHERE ${baseConditions} AND <date/status condition>` therefore applies the additional condition only to the second branch, because AND binds more tightly than OR. Team bookings in the first branch can then be counted outside the requested date range or status. Return an enclosing parenthesized predicate in this path as well, so the base conditions remain a single expression when used in a larger raw query.
